title: Robert Maxwell PROMIS software sold to national labs

tellings.quote: this sort of promise software. Are you familiar with this that Robert Maxwell, you know, who obviously is intimately connected with Epstein, sold to our national labs

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, speaking with Bill Richardson, a former US Secretary of Energy, asks about a piece of software called PROMIS. Michels says that Robert Maxwell, a man he describes as closely connected to the financier Jeffrey Epstein, sold this software to America's national labs, the government-run science and weapons laboratories. If true, it would mean someone with murky connections had software running inside the country's most sensitive research sites.
